```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
```


```{r}
getwd()
bird_data <- read_csv("./Data/split_data.csv")

# make unique sites, dates, and species combos
all_sites <- unique(bird_data$Site)
all_dates <- unique(bird_data$Date)
all_species <- unique(bird_data$CommonName)

# Expand full grid: every Site x Date x Species combo
full_grid <- expand_grid(Site = all_sites,
                         Date = all_dates,
                         CommonName = all_species)

#  counts summarized by Site + Date + Species
site_date_species <- bird_data %>%
  group_by(Site, Date, CommonName) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(`Number of Individuals`), .groups = "drop")

# Join to full grid fills in zeros where missing
site_date_species <- site_date_species %>%
  right_join(full_grid, by = c("Site", "Date", "CommonName")) %>%
  mutate(Abundance = replace_na(Abundance, 0))

# Pivot wider to make species matrix
site_species_matrix <- site_date_species %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CommonName,
              values_from = Abundance) %>%
  arrange(Site, Date)

# build the matrix, remove Site and Date columns
site_species_matrix_filtered <- site_species_matrix %>%
  mutate(row_total = rowSums(select(., -Site, -Date))) %>%
  filter(row_total > 0)

bird_matrix <- site_species_matrix_filtered %>%
  select(-Site, -Date, -row_total) %>%
  as.matrix()

site_factor <- factor(site_species_matrix_filtered$Site)

```


```{r}
# SIMPER analysis pt1

simper_results <- simper(bird_matrix_sqrt, site_factor)

simper_summaries <- summary(simper_results)

important_species_all <- lapply(simper_summaries, function(s) {
  s$cumsum <- cumsum(s$average / sum(s$average) * 100)
  rownames(s[s$cumsum <= 80, ])
})

important_species_all
```


```{r}
#SIMPER pt2


# All SIMPER pairwise summaries combine
simper_summaries <- summary(simper_results)

pair_names <- names(simper_results)


simper_all <- map2_dfr(
  simper_summaries,
  pair_names,
  ~ {
    df <- as.data.frame(.x)
    df$Species <- rownames(df)
    df$cumsum <- cumsum(df$average / sum(df$average) * 100)
    df$Comparison <- .y
    df %>%
      filter(cumsum <= 80) %>%
      select(Comparison, Species, average, sd, ratio, ava, avb, cumsum)
  }
)


print(simper_all)
```



```{r}
# Run NMDS again with SIMPER scores for first pairwise site comparison
nmds_simp <- metaMDS(bird_matrix_sqrt, k = 2)


species_scores <- scores(nmds_simp, display = "species")
species_scores <- as.data.frame(species_scores)
species_scores$species <- rownames(species_scores)


species_scores_filtered <- species_scores[species_scores$species %in% important_species, ]

# NMDS site scores with SIMPER
site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_simp, display = "sites"))
site_scores$Site <- site_species_matrix_filtered$Site

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = factor(Site)), size = 3) +
  geom_segment(data = species_scores_filtered,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = species_scores_filtered,
            aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, label = species),
            size = 3, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  stat_ellipse(data = site_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, group = Site, color = factor(Site))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "NMDS with Top SIMPER Species",
       color = "Site")
```



```{r}
install.packages("pairwise.adonis")
```

```{r}
#yay working pairwise PERMANOVA

library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)

# Matrix: numeric species counts
bird_matrix_pair <- site_species_matrix %>%
  select(-Site, -Date)

bird_matrix_pair[] <- lapply(bird_matrix_pair, as.numeric)
bird_matrix_pair <- as.matrix(bird_matrix_pair)

# Site factor
site_factor_pair <- factor(site_species_matrix$Site)

# Remove empty rows
row_totals_pair <- rowSums(bird_matrix_pair)
bird_matrix_pair <- bird_matrix_pair[row_totals_pair > 0, ]
site_factor_pair <- site_factor_pair[row_totals_pair > 0]


bird_matrix_pair <- sqrt(bird_matrix_pair) + 1

# Distance matrix
birds_distmat <- vegdist(bird_matrix_pair, method = "bray")

# Pairwise PERMANOVA
pairwise_results <- pairwise.adonis(
  x = bird_matrix_pair,
  factors = site_factor_pair,
  sim.method = "bray",
  perm = 999,
  p.adjust.m = "bonferroni"
)

print(pairwise_results)

write_csv(pairwise_results, "C:/Users/chick/OneDrive/Documents/Birdies/pariwise_results.csv")
```


```{r}
#pairwise PERMANOVA heatmap

library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Separate comparssion pairs to two columns
pairwise_df <- pairwise_results %>%
  separate(col = pairs, into = c("Site1", "Site2"), sep = " vs ") %>%
  mutate(p.value = as.numeric(p.value),
         R2 = as.numeric(R2))

# matrix for heatmap
heatmap_data <- pairwise_df %>%
  select(Site1, Site2, R2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Site2, values_from = R2)

ordered_levels <- as.character(1:11)

pairwise_df <- pairwise_df %>%
  mutate(Site1 = factor(Site1, levels = ordered_levels),
         Site2 = factor(Site2, levels = ordered_levels))

ggplot(pairwise_df, aes(x = Site1, y = Site2, fill = R2)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Pairwise PERMANOVA (R² from PERMANOVA)",
       x = "Site", y = "Site", fill = "R²") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#indicator species analysis

library("indicspecies")
data(site_species_matrix)

bird_matrix_raw <- site_species_matrix %>%
  select(-Site, -Date) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

bird_matrix_raw[] <- lapply(bird_matrix_raw, as.numeric)
bird_matrix_raw <- as.data.frame(bird_matrix_raw) 

factor_site <- factor(site_species_matrix$Site)

row_totals_indc <- rowSums(bird_matrix_raw)
bird_matrix_raw <- bird_matrix_raw[row_totals_indc > 0, ]
site_factor_zero <- factor_site[row_totals_indc > 0]

indval_results <- multipatt(bird_matrix_raw, factor_site, func = "IndVal.g", control = how(nperm=999))

summary(indval_results)
```

```{r}
#Table for indicator species analysis


library(dplyr)
library(tibble)


summary_obj <- summary(indval_results)

sig_df <- indval_results$sign %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Species") %>%
  filter(p.value <= 0.05)

sig_df <- sig_df %>%
  mutate(Groups = apply(select(., starts_with("s.")), 1, function(x) {
    paste(which(x == 1), collapse = ",")
  })) %>%
  select(Species, stat, p.value, Groups) %>%
  rename(IndVal = stat, p_value = p.value)

css <- c("1", "2", "5", "7", "9")
chaparral <- c("3", "4", "11")
mixed <- c("6", "8", "10")

sig_df <- sig_df %>%
  mutate(Vegetation = sapply(strsplit(Groups, ","), function(group_list) {
    group_list <- trimws(group_list)
    types <- unique(c(
      if (any(group_list %in% css)) "Coastal Sage Scrub" else NULL,
      if (any(group_list %in% chaparral)) "Chaparral" else NULL,
      if (any(group_list %in% mixed)) "Mixed" else NULL
    ))
    paste(types, collapse = ", ")
  }))
library(gt)

sig_df %>%
  arrange(desc(IndVal)) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Significant Indicator Species by Vegetation Type") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(IndVal, p_value), decimals = 3)

write_csv(sig_df, "C:/Users/chick/OneDrive/Documents/Birdies/sig_df.csv")

```



```{r}
# Jaccard Index, used heat map (ugly)

library(vegan)

row_totals_jac <- rowSums(bird_matrix)
bird_matrix_jac <- bird_matrix[row_totals_jac > 0, ]
site_factor_jac <- site_factor[row_totals_jac > 0]

bird_matrix_jac_pa <- decostand(bird_matrix_jac, method = "pa")
jaccard_dist <- vegdist(bird_matrix_jac_pa, method = "jaccard")
nmds_jac <- metaMDS(jaccard_dist)
nmds_points_jac <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_jac))
nmds_points_jac$Site <- site_factor_jac

jaccard_matrix <- as.matrix(jaccard_dist)
heatmap(jaccard_matrix,
        Rowv = NA, Colv = NA,
        col = viridis::viridis(100),
        scale = "none",
        margins = c(5,5),
        main = "Jaccard Dissimilarity Heatmap")


```


```{r}
# dbRDA plot with species plotted

library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)

veg_data <- read_csv("C:/Users/chick/OneDrive/Documents/Birdies/split_data.csv")

veg_species <- veg_data %>%
  group_by(Site, CommonName) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CommonName,
              values_from = Count,
              values_fill = 0)

env_data <- veg_data %>%
  distinct(Site, `Vegetation Type`)

env_data <- veg_species %>%
  select(Site) %>%
  left_join(env_data, by = "Site")

veg_matrix <- veg_species %>%
  select(-Site) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(veg_matrix) <- veg_species$Site
all(rownames(veg_matrix) == env_data$Site)


env_data$`Vegetation Type` <- as.factor(env_data$`Vegetation Type`)


dbRDA_result <- capscale(veg_matrix ~ `Vegetation Type`, data = env_data, distance = "bray")

summary(dbRDA_result)


site_scores_dbrda <- scores(dbRDA_result, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Site")

species_scores_dbrda <- scores(dbRDA_result, display = "species") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "CommonName")


veg_centroids <- scores(dbRDA_result, display = "cn") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "VegetationType")


veg_centroids$VegetationType <- gsub("^Vegetation Type", "", veg_centroids$VegetationType)
veg_centroids$VegetationType <- gsub("^VegetationType", "", veg_centroids$VegetationType)


library(ggplot2)

ggplot() +
  # Sites aslabels
  geom_text(
    data = site_scores_dbrda,
    aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2, label = Site),
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +

  # Vegetation centroids
  geom_point(
    data = veg_centroids,
    aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2),
    color = "red",
    size = 3,
    shape = 23,
    fill = "red"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = veg_centroids,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1, yend = CAP2),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "red"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = veg_centroids,
    aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2, label = VegetationType),
    color = "red",
    nudge_y = 0.1,
    size = 3
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = species_scores_dbrda,
    aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2, label = CommonName),
    color = "blue",
    nudge_y = -0.1,
    size = 2.5
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "dbRDA1",
    y = "dbRDA2",
    title = "dbRDA: Sites, Vegetation Centroids, and Bird Species"
  )
```

```{r}
#Baselga's total beta diversity measure using sorensen
library(betapart)
library(tidyr)
library(betapart)

bird_matrix_pa <- ifelse(bird_matrix > 0, 1, 0)
bird_matrix_pa <- bird_matrix_pa[, colSums(bird_matrix_pa) > 0]

beta.core <- betapart.core(bird_matrix_pa)

beta_multi <- beta.multi(beta.core, index.family = "sorensen")
print(beta_multi)


```



```{r}
#Dominant Vegetation Table

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)


bird_data <- read_csv("C:/Users/chick/OneDrive/Documents/Birdies/split_data.csv")


total_obs <- nrow(bird_data)


summary_table <- bird_data %>%
  group_by(CommonName) %>%
  mutate(TotalSpeciesCount = n()) %>%
  group_by(CommonName, `Vegetation Type`) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Vegetation Type`, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(c("Chaparral", "Coastal Sage Scrub", "Mixed")))) %>%
  mutate(
    PercentOfTotal = round(100 * Total / total_obs, 2),
    Prop_Chaparral = round(Chaparral / Total, 3),
    Prop_Coastal = round(`Coastal Sage Scrub` / Total, 3),
    Prop_Mixed = round(Mixed / Total, 3),
    DominantVeg = case_when(
      Chaparral >= `Coastal Sage Scrub` & Chaparral >= Mixed ~ "Chaparral",
      `Coastal Sage Scrub` >= Chaparral & `Coastal Sage Scrub` >= Mixed ~ "Coastal Sage Scrub",
      Mixed >= Chaparral & Mixed >= `Coastal Sage Scrub` ~ "Mixed"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(CommonName, Total, PercentOfTotal, Prop_Chaparral, Prop_Coastal, Prop_Mixed, DominantVeg) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
print(summary_table)

write_csv(summary_table, "C:/Users/chick/OneDrive/Documents/Birdies/summary_table.csv")
```
